children.description: Specifies the maximal amount of mode request repetitions without a respective mode indication from the CanIf module until the CanSM module reports a Default Error to the Det and tries to go back to no communication.

children.name: CanSMBorCounterL1ToL2
children.description: This threshold defines the count of bus-offs until the bus-off recovery switches from level 1 (short recovery time) to level 2 (long recovery time).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: CanSMBorTimeL1
children.description: This time parameter defines in seconds the duration of the bus-off recovery time in level 1 (short recovery time).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: CanSMBorTimeL2
children.description: This time parameter defines in seconds the duration of the bus-off recovery time in level 2 (long recovery time).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: CanSMBorTimeTxEnsured
children.description: This parameter defines in seconds the duration of the bus-off event check. This check assesses, if the recovery has been successful after the recovery reenables the transmit path. If a new bus-off occurs during this time period, the CanSM assesses this bus-off as sequential bus-off without successful recovery. Because a bus-off only can be detected, when PDUs are transmitted, the time has to be great enough to ensure that PDUs are transmitted again (e. g. time period of the fastest cyclic transmitted PDU of the COM module / ComTxModeTimePeriodFactor).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: CanSMBorTxConfirmationPolling
children.description: This parameter shall configure, if the CanSM polls the CanIf_GetTxConfirmationState API to decide the bus-off state to be recovered instead of using the CanSMBorTimeTxEnsured parameter for this decision.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
